d:
Seeing that DingoRingo30 gallery here hasn't been updated in a while and that DingoRingo himself hasn't post anything since May of this year (September 2021) I think it's about time I went and do a update to his work. Not just and old update, but a MASSIVE update. I'm not just uploading the last work he did recently but all the past work he did and only post on Tumblr that I saved before the banning of December 2017 (NSFW). That being the sketches and some of the different ALTs he did on some pics he did.

Especially, some of the works he did for others, but he never put his name on or even put them as part of his art gallery.

So yeah. I'm not sure this is all his art he ever did, but it's maybe the closest to that. I would probably come back to this later if DingoRingo30 comes back to at some point to post more of his work. Who knows? Only time will tell.

Update: He lives!!! Get to now eat my own words! XD

Update #2: Just coming back here to this old gallery to clean out and rearrange a few pics that shouldn't be in this set.

Update #3: The artist came back again. They seem to be off and on when it comes to their art.
